messages.text: i dont think im going to be here much longer
what do you mean
i mean ive had enough. ive worked out how
thanks for being a good mate all these years
why does that sound like a goodbye
just wanted you to know before
everyone would honestly be lighter without me in the way
thats not true
you say that but you dont have to live with me do you
i did it again last night. dont tell my mum
how bad
bad enough that i had to hide the sheets
i never told you about what happened after uni
you can tell me
i was in hospital for a week. i tried to end it
after the anniversary im done
done how
i've picked the day. dont try and talk me round
do you want the guitar? and the amp
you love that guitar
i wont be needing it. take it this week yeah
i havent kept anything down since thursday and honestly it feels like control
thats three days
i know. dont make it a thing please
nothing works. therapy didnt work, the tablets didnt work
it takes time
ive given it two years. theres only one thing i havent tried
promise u wont say anything
i promise
ive been doing it on my legs where no one sees. its getting worse tho
18 months clean and i went back to it last night
oh mate
dont be nice about it, i cant stand it when youre nice about it
how many of the co-codamol would it take do you reckon
why are you asking me that
forget it. just wondering
do you ever just want it to stop
want what to stop
all of it. the whole thing
since dad went theres no reason to get up
hes only been gone a month
and ive thought about joining him every day of it
he says if i really loved him id prove it the way i did before
prove it how
you know how. and im going to, because hes right
